recommendation_summary: The reply recommends setting up a free hosted dead-man's switch such as healthchecks.io, pinged at the end of `nightly-sync`, that alerts the user if no ping arrives by about 05:00.

labels.Requirements and who asked: you want to know within a day when `nightly-sync` doesn't finish, without reading logs.
labels.Deleted: central log on the Synology, Docker stack, self-hosted monitoring. You said you won't read logs, and a log can't report a run that never happened.
labels.Bottleneck: nothing raises an alarm when the success email *doesn't* arrive. Silence looks the same as "fine."
labels.Checked myself: nothing on the machines; this is based only on what you told me (cron at 03:00 on `edna`, success email, four silent nights from an expired token, no other alerting).
